The smallest table in the game and the only reason the map exists. LANTRIC LIVES NOWHERE ELSE IN CAELORA. Voltwick is otherwise reachable only by raising a Fizzlet through the whole of Route 7, so this yard hands a player the Spark line in one afternoon if they followed the wires, and never mentions it if they did not. That is the correct shape for an optional: it pays properly, and nobody in the world tells you it is there.

Three slots only, because the yard is a hundred and fifty tiles of rough grass inside a fence and a nine-entry table would be pretending to be a habitat. Fizzlet is more than half of it so a player who wants the evolution rather than the rarity gets one quickly; Lantric is roughly one in six and is the thing worth the walk. Levels 28-31, at the top of the road, because this is the last optional before the capital and anybody standing here has done everything else.
